subject: MAP: SOC 2 package + security review - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T15:10:00Z
Subject: MAP: SOC 2 package + security review - next steps

Hi Daniel - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment on the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone for security review / SOC 2 package delivery.

Recap (high level):
- You're evaluating Redwood for customer-facing ML features; security review is a gating item for your security/compliance team.
- Primary contacts: Daniel Park (Aurelia security), Marissa (Redwood AE), Rishi (Redwood security eng).

Draft MAP milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package
- Goal: Provide Aurelia with SOC 2 artifacts and a responses + evidence index to satisfy your security questionnaire.
- Target close date for this milestone: 2026-11-05 (we can adjust if your review needs more time).
- Dependencies: your security questionnaire review turnaround, any additional evidence requests, confirmation of network/VPC requirements for Private deployment (if pursued).

Responsibilities / Owners
- Redwood (Marissa / Rishi): deliver completed SOC 2 questionnaire, evidence-index PDF, and follow-up Q&A within 5 business days of receiving your questionnaire.
- Aurelia (Daniel / security team): return completed questionnaire and any evidence gaps within 3 business days of receiving our package; confirm if you need an NDA or additional access.

Attachments I'm sending now:
- redwood_soc2_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (our SOC 2 questionnaire template pre-populated where possible)
- evidence-index.pdf (index of common evidence we can provide and typical delivery timelines)
- MAP-draft-aurelia-redwood.xlsx (simple milestone spreadsheet with dates/owners)

Next actions
1) I'll upload the docs to the shared Drive link (below) and email you the HubSpot MAP record.
2) Please confirm the person on your side who will manage the questionnaire and whether 2026-11-05 works as a target for completion of this milestone.
3) Rishi will be on standby for any technical evidence requests (encryption, key management, network configs).

Shared links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_soc2_docs
HubSpot MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4491

Thanks - appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package + security review - next steps

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. I'm looping in our security mailbox (security@aurelia-tech.com). Two quick items from our side:

1) Primary owner: I will own coordinating the questionnaire; we'll assign SMEs for specific sections (infra / app / IAM).
2) Timeline: 2026-11-05 is aggressive but doable if we get the docs today. If we need more time we'll push to 2026-11-12.

Please confirm whether you have a redacted SOC 2 report or just the questionnaire/evidence index. Also our legal team may request an NDA before we share some internal diagrams - I'll confirm.

Thanks,
Daniel
Senior Security Analyst
Aurelia Tech
daniel.park@aurelia-tech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package + security review - next steps

Thanks Daniel - attaching the package now. To clarify: we can provide the following immediately:

- Our completed questionnaire template (redwood_soc2_questionnaire_v1.xlsx) - we pre-filled sections where public info applies and left placeholders where we need your inputs.
- Evidence index (evidence-index.pdf) - lists typical evidence, owner (Redwood vs customer), and expected delivery times.
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 report under NDA; otherwise we provide our SOC 2 summary letter and control mappings.

MAP-draft highlights (from the spreadsheet):
- Milestone A: Share questionnaire + evidence index - owner: Redwood - due: 2026-10-26 (done - attached).
- Milestone B: Aurelia completes questionnaire + flags gaps - owner: Aurelia - due: 2026-10-29 (3 business days).
- Milestone C: Redwood provides evidence for items owned by Redwood - owner: Redwood (Rishi) - due: 2026-11-02.
- Milestone D: Follow-up Q&A / final sign-off - due: 2026-11-05 (target).

If Aurelia needs a redacted SOC 2 before starting, we can get legal to push the redacted report within 24-48 hours once an NDA is signed - let me know.

Rishi - looping you in on expected evidence requests: encryption at rest keys, KMS integration docs, audit log config, retention policies, employee access lists. Can you confirm estimated delivery times on the ones you own?

Thanks - attaching files and Drive link again.

--
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package + security review - next steps

Marissa / Daniel - quick status from our side on evidence items:

- KMS / Key management docs: draft ready, will attach to Drive by 2026-10-28.
- Encryption at rest: config screenshot + architecture diagram - ETA 2026-10-29.
- Audit logging: sample logs + retention policy doc - ETA 2026-10-29.
- Employee access lists (redacted): need confirmation of fields Aurelia needs - target 2026-11-02.

If Aurelia provides the completed questionnaire by 2026-10-29 we should be able to hit Milestone C delivery (2026-11-02).

Also noted: if you require Private deployment network diagrams we'll need network / VPC requirement details from Aurelia (peering, allowed CIDRs) - that is a dependency that could push the final sign-off.

-Rishi
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package + security review - next steps

Marissa - quick update from our SMEs: we'll complete the questionnaire by EOD 2026-10-29 and upload to the Drive link. Legal confirmed they'll sign the mutual NDA by 2026-10-28 (they'll send DocuSign). The Aurelia SME for infra will send VPC requirement checklist by 2026-10-30 - that shouldn't block the evidence you've listed.

Based on this, we're good to keep the target Milestone D date of 2026-11-05. Thanks for the fast turnaround on your side.

Daniel
